reasonPriorTurnEnded: Supervisor emitted an ordinary failure; STATE prescribed terminal checkpoint/no automatic waiting. Agent ended after static work without using available asynchronous user-input interaction. No repository function can force client liveness.
changes: Separate measured resource admission and structured temporary disposition. Continue known useful low-impact work, otherwise checkpoint and request user input; no polling/resume daemon. Budgeted memory, projected CPU, foreground risk replace process-name veto/fixed6GiB. Explicit peak measurement and owner stop retained.

clientEvidence.officialFinding: Pending requests can be cleared by turn completion/start/interruption. Documentation does not prove current client will preserve an awaiting state.
